### Business and Markets

Business value depends on payment proof, customer pull, operating translation, trust, channel control, and infrastructure that can be financed and built. Lovable strengthens the AI-built product branch but keeps hosting, security, integrations, and human judgment as adoption gates. VOL.213 adds a source-scoped consumer-health product note: repellents are evaluated by active ingredient, concentration, coverage, and reapplication rather than branding or gadget format.
